# Environment-editor fixtures

Contract fixtures for the `ED-*` environment-editor program.

- `compatibility-baseline.v1.json` — generated by
  `npm run fixtures:environment-editor`. Pins `worldHash`, `roadNetworkHash`,
  `lidarGeometryHash`, normalized feature transforms, and the placement
  catalog for the built-in IGVC template, the committed `yard` v2 and
  `city-grid` v3 environments, and the synthetic `all-props` environment.
  Any change to these values is a metric-identity contract change and must be
  reviewed as such.
- `legacy-v2.yard.json` — a schema-v2 manifest with the legacy
  `clientRevision` field, every built-in prop type, an intersection, a one-way
  edge, and a building. Never rewritten on read.
- `legacy-v3.city-grid.json` — a committed copy of
  `server/data/environments/city-grid.json` at the time ED-01 landed. The live
  data directory is mutable, so tests read this copy.
- `all-props.v3.json` — synthetic v3 environment exercising every prop type
  (including directional signs), a shouldered road, a building, and an earth
  source record.
- `object-graph-cases.v1.json` — declarative validation matrix for
  `validateObjectGraph`: each case lists legacy records, candidate object
  records, and the exact issue codes expected.
- `schema-v4.sample.json` — a hand-authored v4 manifest with a group, skybox,
  tile, props, and an unregistered vendor type that must round-trip verbatim.
